messages:
Alex M: seeing a sudden spike in TLS handshake failures from ap-south -> edge-1 over the last 10m. errors look like 'session ticket replay detected' in the edge logs, and p99 latency up ~120ms. anyone else seeing this?
Priya S: confirmed on telemetry, same timeframe. bulk from mobile clients and some sdk-based bots. span traces show a bunch of TLS 1.3 early_data/0-RTT rejects.
Matt G: fwiw deploy-bot shows an infra deploy around 6168999400 that touched the edge proxy config (ALPN/cipher-policy). tagging deploy-bot here: @deploy-bot can you paste the commit? :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: deploy 6168999400 by infra/edge-config - changed TLSPolicy v3 -> v4 (removed legacy-session-ticket-fallback, tightened ciphers).
Alex M: ah that aligns. but replay-detected is different from cipher mismatch. could be session ticket key mismatch between proxies or rotator.
Priya S: checked keystore-audit-bot: there are intermittent KMS Decrypt DENY entries at 6168999425 for role edge-keystore-access in eu-west and ap-south. snippet:```WARN KMSDecryptDenied principal=role:edge-keystore-access resource=arn:kms:... status=403```
keystore-audit-bot: recent IAM change: role edge-keystore-access had perms removed in RBAC PR #8123 at 6168999005 (by infra-ops).
Dana R: if the rotator couldn't unwrap ticket-encryption keys because of KMS denies, proxies might reject session tickets as replayed (or stale), and fall back to full handshake causing latency. Good catch.
eng-oncall: can we confirm if this is region-scoped? telemetry shows higher failure ratio in ap-south and eu-west-2, low in us-west.
Alex M: run these quick checks: 1) curl -v to edge host and note TLS resumption behavior; 2) openssl to dump session ticket info. e.g.:
```
openssl s_client -connect edge-1.ap-south.redwood.ai:443 -tls1_3 -alpn h2 -sess_out /tmp/sess.pem
# then reuse
openssl s_client -connect edge-1.ap-south.redwood.ai:443 -tls1_3 -alpn h2 -sess_in /tmp/sess.pem
```
Priya S: i've run a couple of these from a repro client. first handshake succeeds, second fails with: "TLS alert 46 (session ticket required) / session ticket replay". also saw log: `ticket-decrypt-failed: unwrap error: kms:AccessDenied`.
Matt G: rolling back the policy change is intrusive. alternative short fix: allow the edge to use fallback static ticket-key for a minute while we restore KMS perms. Is that doable?
Dana R: yes we have a documented safe fallback in the rotator runbook. but we must watch for potential replay if attacker had tickets — mitigation: limit validity and emit audit events.
eng-oncall: action items: - Dana to restore RBAC for edge-keystore-access (KMS decrypt) - Matt to flip rotator to fallback mode for ticket keys for ap-south canary - Priya to enable verbose keystore audit and attach logs - Alex to monitor handshake failure rate and p99 latency
Dana R: I'm reapplying the RBAC binding now (rolling IAM change). I will update once KMS decrypts succeed in logs.
keystore-audit-bot: IAM change applied by Dana R at 6169000105. starting keystore rehydration job.
Priya S: enabling verbose audit for keystore and proxy auth around keys. also adding temporary debug sampling on TLS handshake paths.
Matt G: starting canary to enable static fallback ticket key on edge-1 in ap-south (no global rollout). command: `kubectl -n infra patch deploy edge-proxy --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"edge/ticket-fallback":"enabled"}}}}}'`
Alex M: after fallback enabled, we see handshake failures drop ~85% in the canary slice and p99 latency returning near baseline. still watching for any abnormal replay counts.
Dana R: KMS decrypt logs now show SUCCESS for previous denied keys at 6169000180. looks like the RBAC restore worked.
eng-oncall: summary so far: root cause = RBAC change removed KMS decrypt for edge-keystore role -> rotator couldn't unwrap session ticket keys -> proxies rejected resumption tickets as invalid/replay -> large number of full handshakes and higher p99 latency.
Priya S: note: deploy earlier that removed 'legacy-session-ticket-fallback' made impact worse. consider restoring a short-term fallback in policy as a safety net for rotator/keystore blips.
Matt G: agreed. we'll add a guard in the next policy change: changes that tighten ticket behavior must be gated with a keystore-perms check. opening infra/edge ticket to track (#INF-1234).
Alex M: closing loop: Dana pls keep audit retention for ticket events for 72h. Priya pls paste the key KMS logs into the ticket. Matt pls schedule a small rollback-safe policy to avoid removal without keystore health check.
Dana R: acked and done.
Alex M: final check at 6169000280: handshake failure rate back to baseline, ticket-decrypt errors gone. marking incident as mitigated. will leave postmortem section in #postmortems with action items. :white_check_mark:
